project.title: gut and hepatopancreas metagenome
project.description: The sampling time was September 22, 2023. The source of the sample was the Litopenaeus vannamei nursery pond of an individual farmer in Wengcuo Village, Taitou Town, Xiuyu District, Putian City, Fujian Province, China.Metagenomic sequencing elucidates the microbial diversity in the gut and hepatopancreas of Glass Shrimp Post-Larvae.
